title: 第一百五十四章 剑气纵横大战爆发第一百五十三章 选择地方伏击王爷
slug: 红楼我乃宗师贾环当登基为帝
lines: 一声巨响，气浪四散。贾环借力后退三步，稳住身形。而铁鹰也被震得手臂发麻，虎口隐隐作痛。他心中大骇，自己这一刀足有千斤之力，对方竟能如此轻描淡写地接下，其内力之深厚，简直匪夷所思。
“你究竟是谁？”铁鹰沉声问道。
“取你主子性命的人。”贾环声音不高，却带着不容置疑的决绝。
话音未落，他再次欺身而上。沧浪剑法再度展开，这一次的剑势，比方才更加汹涌、更加狂暴。如果说刚才只是江河入海，那此刻便是钱塘大潮。
剑光层层叠叠，一浪高过一浪，每一剑都蕴含着排山倒海的力量，压得铁鹰步步后退，只能勉力招架，毫无还手之力。
另一边，叶天士的身影在混乱的亲卫中穿梭。他不出手则已，一出手便是杀招。
或是银针封喉，或是毒粉迷眼，或是以巧劲击打人身穴位，看似轻飘飘的一掌，却能让一个壮汉瞬间瘫软。他如同一位优雅的死神，从容不迫地收割着生命，为贾环清扫着一切障碍。
车厢之内，裕王听着外面的惨叫声和兵刃交击声，吓得魂飞魄散。他掀开车帘一角，正好看见贾环一剑将一名亲卫队长的心口刺穿，鲜血溅了他满脸。
“啊！”裕王惊叫一声，手脚并用地爬到车厢的另一头，抽出挂在车壁上的一把镶满宝石的匕首，色厉内荏地吼道：“来人！护驾！护驾！杀了他们，本王赏银万两，封万户侯！”
然而，他的许诺已经无人能听。他最倚仗的统领铁鹰，此刻已在贾环的剑下险象环生。
“沧浪剑法·惊涛拍岸！”
贾环一声低喝，剑势陡然一变，原本连绵的剑光瞬间凝聚成一道巨大的剑影，如同掀起的滔天巨浪，狠狠地拍向铁鹰。
铁鹰瞳孔骤缩，自知无法抵挡，只能将***横在胸前，拼尽全身功力硬抗。
刀剑相交，铁鹰的***应声而断，整个人如断线的风筝般倒飞出去，重重地撞在山壁上，喷出一大口鲜血，再也爬不起来。
通往裕王马车的最后一道屏障，被彻底清除。
贾环提着剑，一步步走向那辆华贵的马车。他的靴子踩在满是血污的土地上，发出“沙沙”的轻响，每一步，都像是踩在裕王的心脏上。
车帘被一把挑开，贾环那张沾着血迹的、冷峻的脸出现在裕王面前。
“你……你不能杀我！我是当朝王爷，是皇亲国戚！你杀了我，天上地下，再无你容身之处！”裕王瘫坐在地，语无伦次地威胁道。
贾环的眼神没有丝毫波动，他看着这个曾经不可一世，草菅人命的王爷，淡淡地说道：“你鱼肉乡里，构陷忠良，害死我义兄满门之时，可曾想过他们也有容身之处？”
裕王一愣，似乎想起了什么，脸上露出极度的恐惧：“是你……原来是你！饶命！饶命啊！本王给你钱，给你所有你想要的……”
回答他的，是贾环手中递出的长剑。
这一剑，没有之前那般波澜壮阔，反而平淡无奇，就像是风平浪静的江面，但其中蕴含的杀意，却足以冻结一切。
content_en:
"Cang!"
There was a loud noise and air waves scattered. Jia Huan took advantage of the force and took three steps back to stabilize his body. Tie Ying was also shaken to the point of numbness in his arms and a dull pain in his mouth. He was horrified. His sword was powerful enough to weigh a thousand pounds, but the other party could take it so lightly. The depth of his inner strength was simply unbelievable.
"Who are you?" Tie Ying asked in a deep voice.
"The person who took your master's life." Jia Huan's voice was low but filled with unquestionable determination.
Before he finished speaking, he stepped forward again. Canglang's sword technique unfolded again, and this time the sword power was more turbulent and violent than before. If just now it was just the river flowing into the sea, then now it is the Qiantang tide.
The sword light was layer upon layer, one wave higher than the other. Each sword contained overwhelming power, which made Tie Ying retreat step by step. He could only parry with all his strength, but was unable to fight back.
On the other side, Ye Tianshi's figure shuttled among the chaotic guards. It's okay if he doesn't take action, but when he does, it's a killing move.
Either silver needles are used to seal the throat, poisonous powder is used to blind the eyes, or acupoints on the body are hit with skillful force. A seemingly light palm can make a strong man become paralyzed in an instant. He is like an elegant god of death, harvesting life calmly and clearing all obstacles for Jia Huan.
In the carriage, King Yu was frightened out of his wits when he heard the screams and the clash of weapons outside. He opened the corner of the curtain and saw Jia Huan pierce the heart of a guard captain with his sword, and blood splashed all over his face.
"Ah!" King Yu screamed, crawled to the other end of the carriage on his hands and knees, pulled out a dagger inlaid with gems hanging on the wall of the carriage, and shouted fiercely: "Come here! Escort! Escort! Kill them, and I will reward you with a reward of ten thousand taels of silver and the title of Marquis of ten thousand households!"
However, no one listened to his promise. Tie Ying, the commander he relied on most, was now in danger under Jia Huan's sword.
"Canglang Sword Technique: Stormy Waves Breaking on the Shore!"
Jia Huan shouted low, and the sword force suddenly changed. The originally continuous sword light instantly condensed into a huge sword shadow, which was like a huge wave set off, slamming hard at Tie Ying.
Tie Ying's pupils shrank suddenly, knowing that he could not resist, so he could only hold his breasts across his chest and use all his strength to resist.
"Boom!"
The swords intersected, and Tie Ying's gun was broken. He flew backwards like a kite with a broken string, hit the mountain wall heavily, spurted out a large mouthful of blood, and could no longer get up.
The last barrier leading to King Yu's carriage was completely removed.
Jia Huan held his sword and walked towards the luxurious carriage step by step. His boots made a soft "rustling" sound when he stepped on the blood-stained ground, and every step seemed to step on King Yu's heart.
The car curtain was opened, and Jia Huan's blood-stained, stern face appeared in front of King Yu.
"You... you can't kill me! I am the prince of the dynasty and a relative of the emperor! If you kill me, there will be no place for you in heaven or on earth!" King Yu slumped on the ground and threatened incoherently.
Jia Huan's eyes did not waver at all. He looked at the prince who was once arrogant and cared little about human life, and said calmly: "When you framed Zhongliang and killed my sworn brother in the village of fish and meat, did you ever think that there was a place for them?"
King Yu was stunned for a moment, seeming to remember something, with extreme fear on his face: "It's you...it's you! Spare your life! Spare your life! I will give you money and everything you want..."
What answered him was the long sword handed out by Jia Huan.
This sword was not as majestic as before, but rather ordinary, like a calm river, but the killing intent contained in it was enough to freeze everything.
